tasks.task: Build a full set-up pack for one AI assistant

items.when: When a custom GPT, Claude Project, Gem or help-desk agent needs instructions, files and tests
When the client says "we want a bot" and nothing about users, sources or limits is fixed
When you want a second prompt spec and first draft to set against your own
When the instructions are drafted, to find risky wording and likely failure cases
When the assistant will live as a custom GPT and you must check what the builder allows
When the assistant will live as a Claude Project with its own files and instructions

tasks.task: Write instructions for an assistant the client already uses

items.when: When you need one copy-ready block that keeps the assistant on topic, honest and safe
When a rough prompt exists, to see it rebuilt in a clear structure before you choose
When you have test cases, to score each version and keep the one that wins

tasks.task: Fix an assistant that gives wrong answers

items.when: When you must show where it fails, with a test set and a pass rule for each case
When you have redacted chats and the approved text, to list wrong answers and retest cases
When answers are weak or uneven and the instructions need tightening
When the fix must be scored on real cases and shipped with a version you can undo
When the cause is unclear, to read real failed chats one by one before changing anything

tasks.task: Write a bot-ready knowledge base from policies and help pages

items.when: When policies, help pages and solved tickets must become one-topic approved answers
When a topic needs a full help article behind the short bot answer
When source pages bury the answer, to rewrite each section answer first
When entries are drafted, to find customer doubts they still leave unanswered
When an entry states a price, time or promise you cannot trace to the client's own text
When entries are drafted, to match every policy and price in them to its source page and date

tasks.task: Split and tag documents so an assistant can find the answer

items.when: When policies or manuals must become short, tagged entries an assistant can find
When a developer runs the search, to agree chunk size, search method and how to test it
When files repeat each other, to remove duplicates and fit the size limit

tasks.task: Test whether the assistant finds the right entry

items.when: When you need questions in customers' words, each with the entry it should use
When wrong sources keep coming back and the search itself needs quality checks

tasks.task: Draft new knowledge entries from recent tickets

items.when: Each month, to find questions the knowledge base misses and draft entries to approve
When there are hundreds of tickets, to rank the themes by how often they come up
When several tickets share one problem and need a short article in the customer's words
When the monthly run should also flag stale help pages, not only missing ones

tasks.task: Write approved answers for orders, refunds and bookings

items.when: When the top five questions each need a short approved answer and a detail line
When refund answers must lead with the decision and follow the written policy
When an answer goes to upset customers, to check promises, facts and tone
Before answers are approved, to trace each price, time limit and policy line to the live policy page

tasks.task: Design the conversation flow with intents and fallbacks

items.when: When you have real customer messages and need intents, a flow map and hand-over points
Before the flow, to sort real tickets into types and see which the bot may answer
When you want a second flow with other questions and recovery paths to compare
When the flow map must be a diagram the client can paste into their docs
When the flow is drafted, to walk test messages through it and mark each path
When people get stuck in the bot, to check its cues, feedback and way back

tasks.task: Write the greeting, AI disclosure, fallback and hand-over lines

items.when: When the bot needs words to say it is an AI, greet, admit a gap and hand over
When button labels and short lines need a few friendly versions to choose from
When fallback lines only say sorry, to say what went wrong and what to do next
When the lines are drafted, to test them read aloud in the words customers use

tasks.task: Set the bot's scope, voice and hard rules on one sheet

items.when: When you need scope, sources and hard rules written before any flow or entry
When the bot needs tone set by situation, with word lists and example lines
When you must list what the bot must never do and how each rule is tested

tasks.task: Set when and how the bot hands over to a person

items.when: When each hand-over point needs a trigger, the words used and what staff receive
When nobody has written who takes a stuck issue and when it moves up
When staff need a summary of the issue and what was tried, so nobody asks twice
When the bot holds on too long, to cut the effort a customer spends to reach help

tasks.task: Write a test set with expected answers and pass rules

items.when: When you need everyday, tricky, off-topic, unsafe and hand-over cases with pass rules
When the client asks how answers will be scored and who reviews them
When an AI will grade the answers and needs a fair scoring guide
When the flow has set paths, to write each as steps and an expected result

tasks.task: Review live bot transcripts and list the fixes

items.when: When the bot is live and you want its wrong answers found before customers complain
When you have a chat export and want resolved, partly resolved and failed chats counted
When each wrong answer needs a proposed fix and a retest case

tasks.task: Check the bot's defences against prompt injection

items.when: When you need safe test cases, a list of control gaps and a retest record
When the bot reads pages, files or emails that could hide instructions
When the bot is custom code and needs defences, tests and spending caps added
When injection and data-request cases must sit in the same test set as the rest

tasks.task: Write guardrail rules for unsafe, off-topic and data requests

items.when: When the bot must refuse jailbreaks, made-up facts and leaks of personal details
When someone asks the bot for their data and staff need the steps and a draft reply
When the client serves the EU and must know which duties apply to the bot
Before customer chats go to a bot vendor, to check data training and liability terms

tasks.task: Retest the bot after a change to prompt, knowledge or model

items.when: When a prompt changed, to run a fixed set of cases and see what got better or worse
When a change is proposed and you need the criteria and comparison plan first
When you need a retest sheet that marks each case pass or fail against last time

tasks.task: Launch a customer-facing support bot

items.when: When a business wants a bot on chat, help desk or social, or must replace a bad one
When the platform is not chosen, to score the options against the client's needs
When the bot should answer from help content and pass unresolved chats to staff
When the client is an online shop and most questions are about orders
Before go-live, to find where the bot can run twice or act without approval

tasks.task: Run monthly bot quality and knowledge upkeep

items.when: Monthly, and straight after any change to prices, policies, products or the model
When last month's tickets should drive new articles and fixes to stale ones
When source documents have no owner or date, to find stale ones each month
When the month's chats need a sample read for wrong and made-up answers

tasks.task: Design a comment-to-DM or WhatsApp lead capture flow

items.when: When a post should trigger a DM by keyword, with follow-up and email capture
When the DM flow needs buttons, fallbacks and a point where a person takes over
When the channel is WhatsApp and needs automatic replies and support flows set up
When the flow should sort people with a few questions before it asks for details
When messages follow up later, to check the consent rules for texts and WhatsApp
Before the flow goes live, to confirm the link it sends people to works and the offer is still on

tasks.task: Set up a staff assistant that answers from company documents

items.when: When staff need one assistant with set sources, rules and example questions
When the staff handbook and procedures must be split so answers can be found
When answers must come from many work apps and respect who may open what
When a small team wants answers from a set of files with no set-up work

tasks.task: Build a shared prompt library for a team

items.when: When staff prompts are rough and each needs a clear, structured version
When a repeat job should become a step-by-step procedure the AI follows each time
When two versions of a prompt compete, to score them on the same cases
Each month, to find weak, clashing or unsafe entries and gaps worth a new one
When the team has no rules on what may be pasted into an AI tool

tasks.task: Spec a custom bot when no ready platform fits

items.when: When the bot must be custom code that answers questions or uses tools
When the bot should run in a visual automation tool with tools, memory and review steps
When customers would rather talk than type, to try a voice version
When the monthly bill worries the client, to see where tokens go and what to cut

tasks.task: Review the quality of an AI pilot, model or classifier

items.when: When pilot results are in and you need an evidence brief and a go or stop result
When no baseline exists, to set the scores and the drop that should raise a flag
When the tool sorts or labels messages and needs cases with expected labels

always.when: When any bot answer states a fact, price or promise you cannot trace to the client
Before entries or bot lines go live, to catch typos and a product named two ways
Before anything customer-facing counts as done, to get the owner's signed review

helpers.when: When instructions need deep tuning against a large test set or across several models
When the bot needs custom code, document search or links to the client's systems
When hand-over depends on routing, queues, hours and service targets nobody has set
When staff need macros and reply templates for the cases the bot hands over
When the bot must create tickets, update the CRM or book slots in other tools
When a vendor's accuracy claim or a classifier's results need a proper statistical check

gaps: No library item writes instructions for a named builder (custom GPT, Claude Project, Gemini Gem, Copilot Studio) with its fields and file limits
No library item splits documents into one-topic entries with customer phrasings and tags; the only chunking items are for developers
No library item writes AI disclosure, greeting, fallback and hand-over lines, or says what disclosure each region requires
No library item builds a retrieval test: questions in customers' words mapped to the entry each should return
No library item reports bot performance: share resolved, hand-over rate, wrong-answer rate and satisfaction by topic
No library item compares support bot platforms for a small business on price, channels and fit
No library item designs Messenger or Instagram bot flows in tools like ManyChat beyond the comment keyword funnel
No library item writes a phone menu, call greeting or voicemail script
No library item sets up a shared team prompt library with names, owners and a review rhythm
No library item removes personal details from chat transcripts before they are reviewed or reused
